sources.title: GitHub - muscgab/JMangaBench_Mixed
sources.snippet: English JMangaBench_Mixed evaluates Japanese manga OCR on both real manga text and controlled synthetic text. It contains 3,286 samples and reports not only one overall score, but also results by data source, text-length group, crop type, scene type, and writing orientation.
